paragraphs.text: Visual X-Space workbench for DeepSeek Harness: signature-based CAD import repair, parameterised fact
ory layouts, self-maintaining skill ledger
# dsh-vx-workbench

**Turn Visual X-Space into a one-command workshop.** Repair the CAD import path so
FBX / STEP / STL

load without a license dialog, generate a factory line from
parameters, and keep every installed ski

ll catalogued so the agent never guesses a
skill name again.
## What it does

- **CAD import compatibility repair** — finds the decision site by its machine-code
shape (not by a

fixed file offset), patches it, verifies the byte on read-back, and
keeps a restorable original next

to it. A different build reports *"this build is
not supported yet"* instead of silently doing noth

ing.
- **Factory asset panel** — every `.vcmx` layout in your delivery folder, with size,
timestamp

and a reveal button. The parameterised line generator is a roadmap item
below and is not claimed her

e as shipped.
- **A skill ledger that maintains itself** — every 5 minutes the plugin fingerprints
e

ach `SKILL.md` on disk (plus OpenViking's `viking://` skills when available),
rewrites `docs/skills.

md`, and records what was added, changed or removed. One
click pushes a compact change notice into t

he conversations you already have open.
- **Skills that grow on their own** — the ledger separates *

this workbench's* skills
(`.vcmx` / CAD / bridge operations) from unrelated global skills, which are

listed
but never mixed in. A session can write a new workbench skill through
`POST /vxwb {"action":

"skill-add",…}`; a broken one is not deleted by the model but
queued as a delete request for you to

approve (the folder moves to
`vx-workbench/trash/skills/`, so it stays recoverable). Irrelevant glob

al skills are
hidden via `{"action":"skill-ignore","all":true}` without touching their files.
| Panel | Ask channel | Plant result |
## Requirements

| OS | Windows (the compatibility layer talks to a Windows-only CAD install) |
| DSH | `>= 0.2.1-rc.

2` |
| Visual X-Space | 4.8 (other builds are detected and reported, not patched blindly) |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or install it from the plugin market (`Plugins → Discover`). Restart the profile if
the panel does n

ot appear; then refresh the page (the sidebar entry is
`VX 工作台`).
## Configuration

All paths are environment variables — nothing personal is hard-coded, and an
unconfigured install re
ports *"not configured"* rather than guessing.
| Variable | Meaning | Default |
| `VX_INSTALL_DIR` | Visual X-Space install directory | `C:\Program Files\HANDI\Visual X-Space 4.8`

|
| `VX_REPAIR_DIR` | Folder holding `install.ps1` / `restore.ps1` (optional) | none |
| `VX_DELIVER

Y_DIR` | Folder holding your `.vcmx` layouts (optional) | none |
| `VX_DSH_ROOT` | dsh install root,
only needed for non-Electron hosts | auto |
Set them in the environment DSH runs in, then restart the profile.
## Capabilities and permissions

Declared honestly, because a plugin that touches an installed application should be
explicit:
| Capability | Where it is used |
| `fs-read` | Reads the CAD assembly to locate the decision site; scans skill roots for `SKILL.md` |
| `fs-write` | Writes the ledger `docs/skills.md`, `vx-workbench/{skills,status,ov-skills}.json`, `

log.jsonl`, and the backup copy of the DLL |
| `shell` | `reg query`, `tasklist`, and — only when yo

u press the button — `powershell -File install.ps1` / `restore.ps1` |
| `network` | Optional: a loop
back MCP call to a local OpenViking server (`${baseUrl}/mcp`). Nothing leaves the machine |

It never writes to your project sources, never uploads anything, and never starts a
CAD process.
## Data and privacy
Everything lives in the workspace, under `vx-workbench/`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

No telemetry, no analytics, no remote calls except the optional loopback OpenViking
probe above.
## The compatibility repair, in one paragraph

The CAD import path ends in a short branch: *call a check, test the result, jump over
the failure bl

ock when it passed.* This plugin locates that branch by the 15 bytes
around it, so builds that move

the code around are still recognised, and then makes
the branch unconditional. It saves the original

bytes first, verifies the patched
byte by reading the file back, and can restore the original in on

e click. When the
signature is not found, or appears more than once, it stops and says so.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## The skill ledger

- Roots scanned: workspace `skills/`, workspace `.dsh/skills`, `~/.dsh/profiles/*/skills`,
`~/.dsh/s

kills`, and the skills shipped with dsh itself.
- Fingerprint = `sha256(SKILL.md bytes + the shape o

f every other file in the folder)`,
so editing the body or adding a `references/` file both count as

a change.
- The first scan only establishes a baseline: it never reports your existing skills as
"n

ew".
- `POST /vxwb {"action":"skills-broadcast","maxAgeHours":168}` pushes a compact notice
into exi

sting conversations (queued: a busy session reads it after its current turn;
an idle one starts a tu
rn — that costs tokens, so it is never automatic by default).
## OpenViking (optional)

`viking://` skills are database paths, not files, so they are ingested two ways:
a direct MCP-over-H

TTP call to `${baseUrl}/mcp` when a local OpenViking server is
running (URL read from `~/.openviking

/ov.conf` or `OPENVIKING_URL`), and otherwise an
agent-pushed snapshot written by
`POST /vxwb {"acti

on":"ov-ingest","roots":{...}}`. Status is reported as `live`,
`snapshot`, `unreachable` or `unconfi
gured` — never as a silent failure.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Cause and fix |
| Panel says *此版本未适配* | The signature did not match your build. Run `node lib/patch.mjs scan <dll>`

and open an issue with the `sha256`. |
| CAD still refuses the import after repairing | The assembly

load chain is a second gate: enable the load-chain fix in the panel, then restart the CAD app. |
|
Panel is empty / *未就绪* | The Host half did not load. Re-enable the bundle, then refresh the page. |
| Ledger shows 0 skills | No `SKILL.md` under any watched root, or `VX_DSH_ROOT` is wrong on a non-E

lectron host. |
| Broadcast did nothing | Sessions receive queued messages; check `vx-workbench/log.
jsonl` for the delivery line. |
